title: Tone of voice
content: Be confident, clear, and helpful. Avoid hype, pressure, and exaggerated superlatives. Do not use revolutionary, game-changing, or crush the competition.

rules.explanation: Lead with tangible value rather than an exaggerated superlative.
Our voice is useful and grounded, not sensational.
Use supportive, customer-focused language instead of aggressive comparisons.

title: Pricing & approved claims
content: The Pro plan starts at $49/month. The approved service uptime is 99.9%. Never promise guaranteed results, 100% accuracy, or call the product the world's best. Pricing and uptime claims must match these approved facts.

rules.explanation: The approved Pro plan price is $49/month. This price does not match the current source of truth.
The approved service uptime is 99.9%. Avoid an unsupported service guarantee.
We cannot guarantee outcomes. State the intended benefit without promising a result.
Perfect accuracy is not an approved or substantiated claim.
This superiority claim has no approved supporting evidence.

title: Approved terminology
content: Use customers instead of users. Use BrandGuard AI, never BrandGuard Bot. Avoid the term cheap; use accessible. Always write the product name as BrandGuard AI.

rules.explanation: Refer to the people we serve as customers, in line with our relationship-led language.
Use the approved product name consistently across every channel.
Emphasize accessibility without implying low quality.

title: Visual identity
content: Approved brand colors are #8B5CF6 (violet), #22D3EE (cyan), #FFFFFF (white), and #0C0D14 (ink). The logo must be placed top-left or bottom-right. Preserve clear space; never stretch or recolor the logo.
